description: Resolve an opaque masked id (tid) to the underlying proxy wallet address. Requires a Polyrank API key (pk_live_… / pk_test_…): set POLYRANK_API_KEY. The MCP sends it as a Bearer token and the API key-auth accepts it — no browser session needed. Then use the resolved wallet with polyrank_get_trader_skill / polyrank_get_trader_calibration.

tid.description: Opaque trader id (tid) from a masked row.

name: polyrank_resolve_tid
title: Polyrank resolve masked id → wallet (API key required)
